mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.status, f.payment_type, f.name, f.delivery_month, f.reservation_deadline, f.price, f.quantity, f.deposit_amount, f.balance_due_date, f.deposit_paid_at, f.paid_at, f.delivered_at, f.purchase_link, f.thumbnail_url, st.id AS subtype_id, st.name AS subtype_name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, sh.id AS shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, m.id AS maker_id, m.name AS maker_name FROM figure f JOIN figure_subtype st ON st.user_id = f.user_id AND st.id = f.subtype_id JOIN figure_type t ON t.user_id = st.user_id AND t.id = st.type_id JOIN shop sh ON sh.user_id = f.user_id AND sh.id = f.shop_id JOIN shop_channel ch ON ch.user_id = sh.user_id AND ch.id = sh.channel_id JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = f.user_id AND m.id = f.maker_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.status, f.payment_type, f.name, f.delivery_month, f.reservation_deadline, f.price, f.quantity, f.deposit_amount, f.balance_due_date, f.deposit_paid_at, f.paid_at, f.delivered_at, f.purchase_link, f.thumbnail_url, st.id AS subtype_id, st.name AS subtype_name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, sh.id AS shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, m.id AS maker_id, m.name AS maker_name FROM figure f JOIN figure_subtype st ON st.user_id = f.user_id AND st.id = f.subtype_id JOIN figure_type t ON t.user_id = st.user_id AND t.id = st.type_id JOIN shop sh ON sh.user_id = f.user_id AND sh.id = f.shop_id JOIN shop_channel ch ON ch.user_id = sh.user_id AND ch.id = sh.channel_id JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = f.user_id AND m.id = f.maker_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.id, f.status, f.payment_type, f.name, f.delivery_month, f.reservation_deadline, f.price, f.quantity, f.deposit_amount, f.balance_due_date, f.deposit_paid_at, f.paid_at, f.delivered_at, f.purchase_link, f.thumbnail_url, f.description, f.created_at, f.updated_at, st.id AS subtype_id, st.name AS subtype_name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, sh.id AS shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, m.id AS maker_id, m.name AS maker_name FROM figure f JOIN figure_subtype st ON st.user_id = f.user_id AND st.id = f.subtype_id JOIN figure_type t ON t.user_id = st.user_id AND t.id = st.type_id JOIN shop sh ON sh.user_id = f.user_id AND sh.id = f.shop_id JOIN shop_channel ch ON ch.user_id = sh.user_id AND ch.id = sh.channel_id JOIN maker m ON m.user_id = f.user_id AND m.id = f.maker_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO figure (user_id, status, name, delivery_month, reservation_deadline, price, quantity, subtype_id, shop_id, maker_id, purchase_link, thumbnail_url, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{request.name}, #{request.deliveryMonth,jdbcType=DATE}, #{request.reservationDeadline,jdbcType=DATE}, #{request.price}, #{request.quantity}, #{request.subtypeId}, #{request.shopId}, #{request.makerId}, #{request.purchaseLink,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{request.thumbnailUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{request.description,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE figure SET name = #{request.name}, delivery_month = #{request.deliveryMonth,jdbcType=DATE}, reservation_deadline = #{request.reservationDeadline,jdbcType=DATE}, price = #{request.price}, quantity = #{request.quantity}, subtype_id = #{request.subtypeId}, shop_id = #{request.shopId}, maker_id = #{request.makerId}, purchase_link = #{request.purchaseLink,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, thumbnail_url = #{request.thumbnailUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{request.description,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE figure SET status = #{status}, payment_type = COALESCE(#{paymentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, payment_type), deposit_amount = COALESCE(#{depositAmount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, deposit_amount), deposit_paid_at = COALESCE(#{depositPaidAt,jdbcType=DATE}, deposit_paid_at), balance_due_date = COALESCE(#{balanceDueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, balance_due_date), paid_at = COALESCE(#{paidAt,jdbcType=DATE}, paid_at), delivered_at = COALESCE(#{deliveredAt,jdbcType=DATE}, delivered_at) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
